description: Non-world (engine/UI/audio) static assets referenced by the first-run game session: fonts, UI textures, and the audio channel setup. World geometry assets are catalogued separately in world_assets.json; the full shader inventory (custom + third-party bundled) and the missing-external-media findings are catalogued in rendering_assets.json.

fonts.format: BMFont (.fnt + glyph atlas .png), loaded via threed.BMFontLoader
fonts.webPort: Use as a standard bitmap/MSDF web font (or re-export via a BMFont-to-CSS/Canvas loader) for the UIOverlay stub.

jme.note: This is actually the game's own custom GLSL shader source tree (DOF, shadow map, normal/parallax mapping, SSAO) despite the 'jme' folder name — see rendering_assets.json -> shaders.customInRepo for the full breakdown; not leftover jME2 binary assets.

uiAndPortraitImages.status: NOT present in this repository — see rendering_assets.json -> uiAndPortraitImages for the external '../media/{ui,portraits,textures/icons/objects}/' paths the engine expects.

audio.description: AudioServer manages named Channels (e.g. music vs. effects) with independent volume; original backend is LWJGL's OpenAL bindings.
audio.webPort: Map each Channel to a Web Audio GainNode feeding a shared AudioContext destination; volumes above map directly to GainNode.gain values (0-100 -> 0.0-1.0).

renderSettings.webPort: These map to three.js scene/camera far-plane, fog distance, and renderer feature toggles (shadow maps, water shader material, animated foliage via vertex shader time uniform).
